_comment: Which shipped binary links which networking stack. Checked by scripts/ci/desktop_dependency_boundary.py.
The desktop app is two binaries: the Tauri app (arc-desktop) and the arc-node sidecar it downloads and runs.
A crate absent from arc-desktop is NOT absent from the installed product when arc-node links it: both are pinned here.
Targets mirror .github/workflows/release-signing-preflight.yml (desktop: rust-target; sidecar: headless target).
Edges are 'normal' (code linked into the binary); build and dev dependencies are not shipped.
Changing a list here is a decision: update any public statement about the dependency in the same PR.

graphs.features: default features (custom-protocol), as tauri build ships them

graphs.role: arc-node sidecar (run by the desktop app and by headless installs)
graphs.features: --features candle, as the release builds it
